decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch with a dedicated product page in a core upholstery segment, it likely meets at least a provisional aspiration level and the firm has enough slack to continue learning from it.

Because it was only mentioned rather than strongly featured, management would see weaker initial signals, but after just one year the uncertainty still justifies keeping it while monitoring whether it can reach acceptable decorative-fabric performance.

Its dedicated page and the clear functional niche of a flame-retardant curtain fabric make it more likely to satisfy aspirations relative to comparable products, so there is little reason to withdraw it quickly.

With only limited website prominence and a relatively niche wool-blend decorative positioning, it is more likely to fall below aspiration and trigger reallocation of resources to stronger lines or new search.

This fabric appears more experimental and only lightly supported on the website, so a medium-sized textile firm with bounded slack would be inclined to discontinue it if early acceptance remains ambiguous.
